summary: Frontend-only testing of OMGTV static landing page completed. All requested data-testid elements present, Telegram CTAs correctly point to https://t.me/omgtv with target=_blank, Hero 'View Plans' smooth-scrolls to pricing, all 4 navbar links scroll to their sections, FAQ accordion expands correctly, Features (8 cards), Testimonials (3), FAQ (5 items), Pricing cards (Quarterly with MOST POPULAR + $130, Annual $480) all render. Mobile (390px) shows sticky-mobile-get-started, nav-mobile-toggle opens mobile-menu, and floating-telegram-button is visible. Matrix rain canvas present. No console errors or page errors detected.

issues: 'Made with Emergent' badge in bottom-right overlaps the sticky-mobile-get-started button text, slightly obscuring it. Consider raising the sticky bar above the badge or adding extra right padding on small viewports. Cosmetic only — button still clickable on most of its surface.
Floating telegram bubble (bottom-20 on mobile) sits very close to the sticky Get Started bar; on small screens they almost touch. Functional but slightly crowded.

critical_code_review_comments: All Telegram CTAs use rel=noopener noreferrer with target=_blank — good security practice.
scrollToId helper (lib/site.js) uses smooth scroll behavior correctly across all sections.
MatrixRain canvas has data-testid and renders; performance looks fine.
No backend code present, matches static-only requirement.

Minor: consider adding bottom padding to the page on mobile to ensure last section content isn't hidden under the sticky CTA bar (currently Contact section content can be slightly covered by the sticky bar).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static landing page at https://stream-hub-pro-8.preview.emergentagent.com. All required data-testid selectors verified on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). No backend. All Telegram CTAs link to https://t.me/omgtv with target=_blank. Matrix rain canvas renders. Only minor design observations regarding mobile bottom-bar overlap with Emergent badge.
